meta.description: 数字故障 / 像散偏移 / 数据腐败标题, 适合视频转场 / cyberpunk hero

copy.tagline: 给视频添加数字故障风格标题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做视频需要炫酷的故障艺术标题
copy.tagline_en: Add glitch-style titles to your videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need cool glitch art titles for videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能生成一张 1920×1080 的故障艺术标题帧，包含主标题、副标题、顶部状态栏、底部时间码和 ASCII 噪点，并带有像散偏移、扫描线、噪声颗粒等动态效果，适合作为视频转场或赛博朋克风格标题。
howto.when: 当你要求制作一个赛博朋克或数字故障风格的视频标题帧，或需要视频转场标题时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个故障风格的标题帧，标题是“SIGNAL LOST”。
say.note: 生成一张带像散偏移和扫描线的故障标题帧。

say.text: 生成一个赛博朋克视频转场标题，主标题“NEON”，副标题“城市之夜”。
say.note: 生成包含主副标题和动态故障效果的帧。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a 1920×1080 glitch art title frame with main title, subtitle, top caption, bottom timecode, and ASCII noise chunks, featuring chromatic aberration, scanlines, noise grain, and dynamic corruption effects, suitable for video transitions or cyberpunk hero titles.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a cyberpunk or digital glitch style video title frame, or a video transition title.

say_en.text: Create a glitch-style title frame with the title "SIGNAL LOST".
say_en.note: Generates a title frame with chromatic shift and scanlines.

say_en.text: Generate a cyberpunk video transition title, main title "NEON", subtitle "City Night".
say_en.note: Generates a frame with main/sub titles and dynamic glitch effects.
